content:
Elena: Quick write-up from the live Q&A for folks who asked for dates + owner names. Keeping it compact.

Jo: API runtime update (runtime v2): internal canary next Tue, partner pilots 3w after, GA ~6w post-pilot. We'll provide an opt-in header/param for callers. No forced migration for pinned models.

Marcus: What exactly is the opt-in param? We need to add to our client config.

Jo: It's lightweight: `X-Redwood-API-Version: v2-runtime` or `?api_version=v2`. We'll publish snippets. Backwards compatibility maintained for 90 days after GA; extended compatibility available via paid support.

Priya: Dedicated/Private ops impact? Customers asked about maintenance windows and SLAs.

Jo: Dedicated: control plane rollout then rolling node updates; mostly non-disruptive but we'll publish per-customer maintenance windows. Private: customer-applied package + checklist. SLA stays the same; we'll include a support plan note for extended windows.

Sam: Console details? People want cost-by-route and canary controls in the UI.

Jo: Console beta (internal + select partners) starts Apr 18. Public opt-in beta mid-May. GA end of Q2. Beta includes token-cost breakdown per route, latency percentiles, and a canary manager (start/stop/rollback).

Elena: Optimize timeline: batching & cache advisor vs quantization recommender?

Jo: Batching/cache advisor = internal alpha in ~2 sprints, public alpha by month-end. Quantization recommender (with per-model quality deltas) targeted for Q3. We'll share an RFC + example eval harness before public alpha.

Marcus: SDK changes? Any breaking surface we should watch?

Sam: Minor streaming frame change: `client.stream()` will emit an extra `partial_func_args` event. We'll open Python/JS PRs after the internal canary and post migration samples. Old streaming frames deprecated 90 days after GA; enterprise add-on for 6mo extension available.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: "canary kickoff: runtime-v2 -> cluster-alpha at 2002345730"

Elena: Action items: 1) @Jo publish timeline + migration checklist by EOD tomorrow. 2) @Sam open SDK PRs and add webhook migration examples. 3) @Priya prepare Dedicated/Private notice templates for CS & Sales. 4) Product to publish beta invite flow.

Jo: Will drop the timeline doc in #eng and update public roadmap.

Sam: I'll queue SDK changes and example snippets.

Priya: Will coordinate with CS on customer-facing language.

Elena: If anyone had a panel question that isn't covered here, paste it and we'll route to the owner. Thanks! :sparkles:
